summary: Erasmus Mundus Journalism is a joint master's in journalism, media and globalisation, with the first year in Aarhus, Denmark. Applications for 2027-2029 are accepted from 1 November 2026 until 10 January 2027 at 13:00 CET. About 10-15 Erasmus Mundus scholarships are expected, each covering a full tuition waiver and EUR 1,400 per month for up to 24 months, plus health and liability insurance.
highlights: Completed bachelor's degree, documented by the programme's cut-off date.
Not eligible if you already hold a master's of at least two years or a previous Erasmus Mundus scholarship.
One application covers both admission and scholarship consideration.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official Mundus Journalism page before applying.
